status_text: No file is cleared. The H-SC1 candidate (q0.90) fails the literal uniqueness gate: its dots lie within 3 px of registry rasters at 100% (a blanket, in the literal screen) and at 99.8% (a 206,895-dot lattice, in the sensitivity run). It also does not clear the paired comparison against random placement. Format checks pass.

flags: LITERAL UNIQUENESS FAIL at q0.90, q0.95 and q0.97. The screen stopped at registry raster 27: apartanish22-droid/ApartGEMSDOE2 docs/downloads/gemsdoe32-h-depth-cond-conductive-under-thin-cover-top37654-20261028T224836Z-e34db98d-nan.tif. Overlap 100%; rank correlation 0.014.

That raster is a BLANKET, not a dot set: 5,106,385 positive cells (98.8% of the footprint), 1.0 everywhere except the 60,988 catalogue cells. A 3-px dot overlap is degenerate against it, so the FAIL measures the definition, not a true duplicate. A gate-definition decision is needed before any file can be cleared.

SENSITIVITY (blankets excluded, evidence/uniqueness_hsc1_q090_sensitivity_noblanket.json; zip-member exclusion added after this run): still FAIL. Genuine dot-set overlaps remain: 13gems r13 lattice (206,895 dots) 99.79%; gems77 h82 ternary-entropy 99.75%; GEMSDOE50 scarpstep 92.4%; GEMSDOE23 habitat 92.1%. Excluding blankets does not clear this candidate.
IRREGULARITY: the file name says top37654 (37,654 dots), but this ApartGEMSDOE2 raster and its sibling copies do not contain 37,654 dots. The GEMSDOE32 focus file does (37,654 dots).
The mirror holds 120 blanket rasters (positive over more than 50% of the footprint). Most are continuous or diagnostic outputs, not dot submissions.

Zeros outside the footprint. Official rule text R1 (evidence/official_rules_check.json) says data outside the bounds is 'null or nan'. The DrivenData reference notebook writes zeros with no NaN step. sample_submission.tif uses NaN. Portal behaviour on either was not tested.

Earlier research already on record (evidence/research_sources.md): the strict all-finite, zeros-outside writer is NOT cleared for submission. A NaN-outside diagnostic variant reproduces the sample's NaN mask but was never uploaded. This H-SC1 file uses the strict writer.
Unexplained portal error 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]'. The file that triggered it has not been identified. The H-SC1 file's values are all 0 or 1.
data/official/labels.tif is byte-identical to data/official/existing_faults.tif (SHA-256 7ba308cc...). Consistent with R5 (labels are the existing-fault catalogue).
Leaderboard conflict: the prompt cites 0.4413 as the current high and 0.3195 as the highest. The leaderboard read on 2026-10-30 shows 0.4544 at the top and no 0.4413 or 0.3195 in ranks 1-22.
Nine focus files: pairwise 3-px overlap 97.6% to 100% (evidence/focus_pairwise_overlap.json). All are above the 70% limit. Only a nine-by-nine check was run.
Holdout uses the global dot set (63,101 at q0.90); the file contains 62,206 (catalogue cells removed). The submitted-policy column is the one that describes the file.

Paired comparison vs matched random placement (5 draws per quantile): candidate minus random is positive in every draw, but the lower 95% bound clears zero in only 2 of 15 draw-quantile pairs. The advantage over random density is not established.

Registry scan: the first full attempt was incomplete (GitHub rate limit, 101 errors). Rerun completed: 113 sites, 0 site errors, 5,384 rasters. 25 per-file errors are excluded with reasons: 24 git symlinks whose blobs are path text, and one 110-byte truncated TIFF header (GEMSDOE63 smoke.tif).
The lane exceeded its 2-hour budget (uniqueness scans are CPU-bound on 2 cores). The third holdout experiment slot was not used.
The full DrivenData prompt is not stored verbatim in this repository. The README carries a condensed brief only.
